vocabulary.meaning: a book in digital form that can be read on an electronic device
examples: I downloaded the e-book to my tablet.

vocabulary.meaning: a portable electronic device designed mainly for reading digital books
examples: Her e-reader can store hundreds of books.
The screen of an e-reader is easy to read outdoors.

vocabulary.meaning: to copy data or a file from the internet to your device
examples: You can download the book in a few seconds.
I downloaded several novels before my holiday.

vocabulary.meaning: an online collection of books, articles, or other reading material
examples: Students can access the university's digital library from home.
The digital library contains thousands of free books.

vocabulary.meaning: a version of a book or publication produced on paper
examples: Some readers still prefer the print edition.
The print edition costs more than the e-book.

vocabulary.meaning: to mark an important part of a digital or printed text
examples: I highlighted several useful sentences in the e-book.
Most reading apps let users highlight text.
